'''Besprun''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] logistics [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who was stationed at [[Belsavis prison]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] penal colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], prior to and during the [[invasion of Belsavis]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Logistics Officer Besprun appears as a Crew Skill Trade Vendor for Republic players on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
